parts.label: a
parts.text:
Four students attempt to define the half-life of a sample of radioactive substance.
Student A
Half-life is half the time for the activity of the sample to decrease to zero.
Student B
Half-life is half the time taken for the activity of the sample to decrease to
half its original value.
Student C
Half-life is the time taken for the activity of the sample to decrease to half
its original value.
Which student has given a correct definition?  ........................................................... [1]
